defective_pattern: Using presentation-style bullets, hyphens, and numbered breakdowns in place of cohesive academic thesis paragraphs.
why_defective: Breaks the formal scholarly register and narrative flow required in academic theses, making the text read like a slideshow rather than a continuous discourse.
observed_symptoms: Frequent bullet points in findings sections
Hyphenated lists or numbered breakdowns in body paragraphs
corrective_remedy: Synthesize points into continuous, cohesive scholarly prose using transition words instead of lists.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: High frequency of <w:numPr> or bullet characters (•, -, 1.) in standard body narrative paragraphs.
